artifacts.source: wordmark and mark on bar wrapper (photo)
artifacts.note: Slab wordmark in uppercase. A turtle drawn in one continuous line sits above it.
Dark brown wrapper covers about 45 percent of the front. Green only on the origin band. Gold foil on the mark.
Close-ups of cacao pods and hands, warm light, no faces, no text on images.
Studio says the identity 'honours the slow patience of the cacao farmer'.

artifacts.source: home and shop pages, desktop and mobile
artifacts.note: Cream ground, brown headings, one product per row, wide margins, green only on origin tags.
Kraft carton with the turtle mark stamped in one colour. Inner tissue in banana-leaf green.
States an 8 px spacing grid, clear space equal to the turtle's shell height, and a ban on placing the mark over photography.
Name given as the founders' family house in Ilheus; jabuti is the Brazilian tortoise.

claims.statement: A single-line turtle gives the mark a hand-drawn, patient feel that matches the product story.
alternatives: The line style is a stock illustration trend, not a story choice
claims.pattern: Draw the mark as one continuous line to signal craft and patience.

implies.requirement: Patience and craft were the brand's core personality traits.

claims.statement: A deep warm field dominates, with one green origin accent and gold reserved for foil.
claims.pattern: Give one deep warm tone nearly half the surface, one cool accent to mark provenance, one metallic for the mark only.

implies.requirement: Provenance had to be signalled at a glance on shelf.

claims.statement: Positioned as slow and farmer-centred against industrial chocolate.
alternatives: Positioned on premium price rather than on process

claims.statement: The idea is the patience of making chocolate slowly.
alternatives: The idea is simply origin, and patience is the studio's after-the-fact framing
claims.pattern: State the idea as a human virtue the process embodies.

claims.statement: The name joins a family house with the tortoise as a symbol of patience.
alternatives: The tortoise was chosen after the name for visual convenience
claims.pattern: Pair a personal place name with an animal that carries the virtue.

claims.statement: An 8 px spacing grid governs layout.
claims.pattern: Fix a base spacing unit and derive every margin from it.

claims.statement: Clear space equals the shell height and the mark never sits over photography.
claims.pattern: Define clear space from a part of the mark itself and ban the mark over busy imagery.

claims.statement: The mark is stamped in a single colour on kraft and wrapped with leaf-green tissue.
claims.pattern: Carry one brand colour inside the pack so unboxing repeats the shelf colour logic.

claims.statement: The site repeats the pack: cream ground, brown type, green only on origin tags.
The guidelines name clear space and a misuse rule.
A cost limit on print colours may have shaped the single-colour stamp on kraft.
alternatives: The single-colour stamp is a purely aesthetic, rustic choice with no cost driver

claims.statement: Research probably found buyers distrust industrial chocolate claims.

_note: FICTIONAL brand Casa Jabuti, end-to-end test case: 12 artifacts/claims gated by the ledger, reconstructed to exit 0.
